summary: This CSS file styles a summary box component that appears at the start of articles. It composes several base utility classes to inherit their styling, then customizes the appearance of the icon, title, and body text to match the site's design system rather than using default framework colors.

explanations.9: The `composes` keyword pulls in styles from another CSS file's `mk-callout` class, so this element inherits all those base styles without rewriting them.
explanations.23: This tells the browser to display the emoji character in plain monochrome text mode rather than its default colorful emoji appearance, so it matches the site's color scheme.
explanations.27: Setting `min-width: 0` overrides a browser default that can cause flex children to overflow; it lets the content shrink as needed.
explanations.47: This selector targets only the last child element inside `.tldrContent` and removes its bottom margin to prevent extra spacing at the end.
explanations.52: This uses a CSS custom property (variable) called `--tone-line` to color the link, making it easy to change the link color across the whole site in one place.
